title: Parish Lesson — What a Pump Station Does in the Rain

meta.audience: A learner or a small group at the Drainage Pumping Station, upper primary.
meta.why: One idea taught at a real parish site, checked with one question, then used straight away in a two-minute game in the parish.
meta.hostNotes: The SmartCiti.X side of the flow contract only (docs/flowhub.md, docs/k12.md): nothing here states how Cognition.X or any other host stores or presents it. The apply node is external: the parishes app or a GRIOT character (by-flow-agent.js) runs the step and posts the resume.
meta.lowConnectivity: Works offline once the page has loaded; the run waits in this browser's own storage.

nodes.title: Pre-brief — What a Pump Station Does in the Rain
nodes.why: The station's own study card, read first, so the learner knows the one idea the lesson is for.

nodes.title: What a Pump Station Does in the Rain
nodes.why: The K-12 station itself, launched from its parish site; a run that does not pass goes back to the brief.

nodes.title: Check question — What a Pump Station Does in the Rain
nodes.why: One question on the idea just taught, answered before the game; a wrong answer shows the why and asks again. Never scored against anyone.

check.q: Why does rain in low ground need a pump?
check.why: Low ground cannot drain downhill by itself, so the pump lifts the water out.

nodes.title: Apply it in the parish — Pump Start-Up Order
nodes.why: A two-minute game at the parish site that uses the idea just taught; the passport records the lesson and the game.

nodes.title: End-of-lesson check-in
nodes.why: The lesson closes on the learner's own answer about how it went, not on a score.
